text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――In 1st place is Shinko Windy...!
Her strength is the real deal...!!
Running with the ferocity of a predator, she displayed an undeniable, overwhelming strength...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! Windy-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: How's that... did you see that...?! Windy-chan is amazing, after all...

Once the post-race excitement had subsided,
she made her way to the winner's circle.
However...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Dead silence...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-What's wrong with you guys...? Windy-chan won, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That's way too amazing! She was this strong!?
Whoa, whoa, look at that powerful stride!
That's insanely cool...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, what terrifying spirit! A true bundle of fighting drive!
It was a breathtaking run...!
I'm still trembling... and my hands are sweating profusely!
(Waaaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAAHHHH!!
Windy-senpaaaaaai!!!
You're amazing! Waaaahhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Congrats~!
You looked so incredibly cool~â
Wah, my heart just won't stop pounding~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What a powerful aura...!
Even after going through such a slump...
You've... truly changed your fate, haven't you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
I wonder if I... could become like that too?
Call it ambition or whatever, but I want to make my own dream come true too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... It was a lo~ng road,
but you truly, truly did fantastic...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, that was so cool...!
Congratulations...!
Congratulations from the bottom of my heart, Senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko... You guys...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That girl... is insane!
Who called her a meme character?!
She's insanely strong, isn't she!?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... See, I told you!
Windy-chan is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
"She believes in herself more than anyone, she's totally wild, and she does things nobody else could without batting an eye...
And she's strong! Seriously strong!"
choice_data_list: Windy, you are so strong! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuugh...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!!
Windy-chan is the stroooongest!!
Gyahahahaaaーー!
She bounded about the area with lively skips, as the crowd showered her with generous applause.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Woo-Indy! —Woo-Indy!
—Woo-Indy! —Woo-Indy!

Everyone acknowledged it now.
'She is strong'...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion~ I'm back. I gave 'em tons of fan service.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Ehehe, hehehehe...!
It feels so strange,のだ.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My arms and legs are flailing all over the place!
I can't sit still at all!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Traineeeer!
Traiiiineeeerrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp*!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nom nom nom...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaaahhhhh!!
It was clearer than day that her happiness was overflowing...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on the victory! That was an overwhelming display of strength. A quick word on how you're feeling right now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, of course it's the absolute best!
Looks like everyone is terrified of Windy-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt! It gave me absolute goosebumps.
I bet we'll see even more Umamusume stepping up to challenge her from now on! I'm already looking forward to battles with the new generation.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
No matter who comes at me,
I'll just strike 'em right back!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Windy-chan...!
To have so many people acknowledge you...
*sniff* I'm so, so happy for you...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy was seriously amazing. The gap between her intense focus and her usual self is wild. Man, I'm definitely a fan...!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-What did you just say?!
Oh, she's wonderful! You definitely need to keep an eye on her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, miss, you're a fan of hers, aren't you?!
If you'd like, could you tell me more?
About Shinko Windy...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Um, I want to know too...!
I used to think she was just a meme character, but...
that raw power when she overtakes someone is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Is that what they call an obsession with winning?
It's kind of dazzling and so cool...!
Were her past races just as amazing?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Yes...! Exactly...!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
"She's not just entertaining!
Her talent is the real deal—!!"
And a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Hehehehe...
The news, social media, video sites, everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The whole world can't stop talking about Windy-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are coming along smoothly, nanoda.
Now, if only the URA gives Windy-chan and the others the prize just as planned...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it, aren't you? My evil tactician. All of Japan is going to be knocked off its feet...!

The public is going wild over her sheer ability.
Even the "biting incident" is steadily becoming a thing of the past.

Operation Prank is... right on track.
Just a little longer until we leave the world
absolutely flabbergasted...!
